1.explanation: To reproduce the bug, create a Quarto Markdown (.qmd) file with the specified YAML front matter. Set `hash-type` to `number` under the `revealjs` format. This will cause the title slide to misalign, as shown in the bug scenario image. Changing `hash-type` to `title` will correct the alignment, demonstrating the issue.
1.bug_scenario: The bug occurs when using `hash-type: number` in a revealjs presentation. The title slide becomes misaligned, with elements not centered properly. This is evident in the provided image where the title and other text are shifted to the left. In contrast, using `hash-type: title` results in a properly aligned title slide, as shown in the second image.
